#### About

## Helpusreshapetheboundariesofcyberrisk

At CyberCube, we strive to make organizations and society more resilient to cyber risk by delivering the world’s leading cyber risk analytics. If you share our passion in making an impact, join us in our mission!

swipe

drag

![beach cropped 2](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/beach%20cropped%202-min.png)

### Our Culture

At CyberCube, we support our employees to do the best work of their career. Our team is full of inspiring, innovative individuals who harness their intellectual rigor when tackling challenges. They don’t always take the conventional approach to solving problems and they work hard to deliver world-leading cyber risk solutions.

CyberCube values collaboration, building trust across our organization, our clients, and the broader industry with knowledge and insight. The wellbeing of our employees is essential to our success, so we work to create a positive, open and diverse workplace. CyberCube puts people at its center, empowering our teams, clients and society to make better, more informed decisions.

![nyc beach volunteering](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/nyc%20beach%20volunteering.jpg)

### Our Responsibility to ESG

In our mission to quantify cyber risk, our team is always focused on the impact we're having on the communities we operate in. We want to make CyberCube a leading innovator in creating ongoing value for society.

Our cross-functional Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) team collaborates to create a workplace that commits to reducing our environmental footprint and maintains standards of corporate governance. As an equal opportunity employer, we proudly champion an inclusive workplace where every team member is valued.

[Read More](https://www.cybcube.com/corporate-social-responsibility)

![Pascal-and-Ashwin_2 edit](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/Pascal-and-Ashwin_2%20edit.jpg)

### Our Leadership

With expertise in cyber security, risk modeling, technology and insurance, our leadership team pull from a wealth of knowledge to drive our mission to deliver world-leading cyber risk analytics. They empower our employees, providing the guidance and resources they need to enable exceptional outcomes for our clients.

Personal development is a priority at CyberCube. Employees are supported and developed to reach their professional potential.

[Read More](https://www.cybcube.com/team/leadership-team/)

#### Values

### OurCoreValues

![collaborating-icon-blue](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/collaborating-icon-blue.svg)

##### Collaborating as a team

Our responsibility is to make everyone around us successful, regardless of their role.

![trust-icon-blue](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/trust-icon-blue.svg)

##### Building trust through openness

We communicate openly, proactively seeking out the input of others and learning from diverse perspectives.

![solving-problems-icon-blue](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/solving-problems-icon-blue.svg)

##### Solving problems with intellectual rigor

We continuously strive to bring cutting-edge expertise in our domain, and bring that rigor into addressing problems.

![value-icon-blue](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/value-icon-blue.svg)

##### Enabling exceptional outcomes for our clients

We put solving the specific problems of our customers at the heart of decision making.

![done-icon-blue](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/done-icon-blue.svg)

##### Driving ownership for excellence

We said we would do it and we work through any obstacle we face to deliver excellence.

## LifeatCyberCube

At CyberCube, employees energize and inspire each other in their work — taking the initiative to look outside the box and discovering new ways to solve problems.

If you want to apply your knowledge and insight to make an impact, CyberCube is the place for you. Find your place with us and start delivering the world’s leading cyber analytics.

[Find your place at CyberCube](https://www.cybcube.com/careers#open-positions)

## Locations

We are expanding globally, with hubs in San Francisco, New York, London and Tallinn, allowing us to support the cyber insurance industry with cyber risk analytics.

- San Francisco










San Francisco is the heart of CyberCube. This is where our journey started and where our headquarters are based. With a multitude of charming restaurants, mild weather and surrounded by nature, life is enjoyable in San Francisco.



Working in the world’s first tech hub means the latest technologies are within easy reach. Numerous meet-ups are held across the bay where you’ll be able to stay on top of the latest trends and meet brilliant people.













![san francisco](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/san%20francisco.jpg)













### Where we're located

- London










CyberCube’s London office is located in the City of London, at the center of the (re)insurance market. Our multi-disciplinary teams spend plenty of time with our London and European clients and prospects, with easy access to the US. London is also one of the world’s most significant financial capitals, with a growing tech sector.



CyberCube hosts a wide range of social activities, ranging from a charity day at a farm to a team outing at the theatre. We’re busy but flexible, placing trust and results first before completing timesheets at the office.













![london](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/london.jpg)

- Tallinn










Our Tallinn office offers a thriving atmosphere to work and develop your career. At the center of a booming technology sector, Tallinn has the highest number of start-ups per person amongst European cities. It offers a plethora of opportunities to learn from brilliant entrepreneurial people.



This culturally-blended medieval town combines history and modernity with quirky galleries, restaurants, and unique sights. At CyberCube Tallinn, we strive to build an environment where smart and sympathetic people can create family ties and produce the best work of their careers at the same time.













![tallinn](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/tallinn.jpg)

- New York City










There’s no doubt that New York is the one of the centers of the world’s financial and insurance markets, which is why we made sure CyberCube had an office located near all the action.



Employees can keep a finger on the pulse of the latest US insurance trends, allowing our multi-disciplinary teams to access our New York-based prospects and clients. The city’s busy, vibrant and cosmopolitan base also provides amazing opportunities for social activities, ranging from Broadway performances to rooftop drinks!













![New-York](https://www.cybcube.com/hubfs/New-York.png)
